tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /dkar bdud kyi bstod pa dge legs phun tshogs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /bhyoḥ dpal gyi bstan skyong ma mo ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ /sku mdog dkar la 'od ldan zhing / /phyag gnyis ri rab gling bzhis brel/ /gser dang rin chen sna tshogs pas/ /rnam par brgyan cing nyi zla yis/ /dbu brgyan sku yi do shal byas/ /sna tshogs dar dang khyad par du/ /gangs dkar mdog can sham thabs gsol/ /zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs/ /me rlung dbus na rab tu brjid/ /dpal ldan dkar mo khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ bdud rnams kun gyi rgyal po ni/ /srin po'i gzugs can ma rung pa/ /bdud rta la zhon glog ltar 'khyug /lcags mdung thod phreng lag na bzung / /dar nag mi lpags na bza' gsol/ /rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /rang 'dra brgyad sogs 'khor gyis bskor/ /bstan pa'i dgra bo'i gshed ma ste/ /bdud rgyal nag po 'khor bcas bstod/ /don la chos kun spros bral yang / /rnam pa rang sems 'khrul snang gi /dam can srung ma'i thugs 'gal bar/ /sems kyi bdag 'dzin mthol lo bshags/ /nyams chag thams cad dag gyur cig /thun mong dngos grub 'bad med du/ /char ltar phob cig srung ma'i tshogs/ /mchog gi dngos grub bdag cag gis/ /tshe 'dir thob par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di ni sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis bris nas bzhi thog bla brang gi dkar mo nyi zla'i mgon khang dngos grub gling zhes bya bar dar dkar la bris nas phul ba yin/ /ka lyā na wardhantu// ༈ //dpal sa skya'i pu tra khang du spyan gzigs phul ba'i 'phrin bcol gyi yi ge bzhugs/ /na ma yakṣa pu tra ya/ rab brjid nam mkha'i mdog 'dra rab 'bar bskal me'i klong na bzhugs/ /rab tu khros pa rab tu gtum pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa po/ /rgyal ba'i bka' ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa srungs shig gnod sbyin bu/

/sa skya pa yi bstan pa sa skya'i gong ma'i bka' ltar sgrubs/ /de ltar sngon gyi 'phrin las bskul ba dang / /rang gi bar chad zhi zhing don bsgrub phyir/ /snyug bzang rgod sgros brgyan cing lcags mdas spras/ /btso ma'i mdog 'dra'i lhab lhub cod pan 'di/ /'khon gyi rigs can shākya'i btsun pa gang / /ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can dad pas 'bul/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan po dang / /da bcol 'bad med 'grub phyir dgyes par bzhes/ /spyir gyi bstan dang khyad par sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag gi dam chos dang / /mthun pa'i don rnams 'bad med 'grub par mdzod/ /spyi dang sgos dang chos mthun don dag la/ /ṇi dang tri las skyes pa'i log 'dren rnams/ /myur du tshar chod chos mthun 'bad med sgrubs/ /chos mthun don rnams 'bad med mi sgrub na/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes don chung bas/ /gtad do gnyer ro bslu med myur du sgrubs/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu sku tshe brtan pa dang / /bdag kyang lo brgya 'tsho bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi chos mthun don rnams legs 'grub cing / /'chad rtsod rtsom sogs dge la rab brtson pas/ /rgyal bstan nam mkha'i nor bu lta bur mdzod/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'grub pa dang / /bsam pa mtha' ru 'khyol bar mdzad du gsol/ /bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i 'phrin las 'chol ba 'di bslu med dkon mchog rnams kyi thugs rje dang / dam can pu tra'i mthu rtsal dang / bdag gi snying nas mos pa la brten bsam don 'bad med du 'grub par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dkar bdud kyi bstod pa dge legs phun tshogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
